barbie-ing-listings.concept: A clearly female canonical Homie poses in a bright pink tailored Barbie-inspired outfit.
barbie-ing-listings.action_expectation: The connected pointing forearm pivots around one fixed elbow while the connected ponytail tail counter-swishes; face, sunglasses, hair cap, torso, planted hand, skirt, legs and heels remain fixed.

pulp-fictioning-manager.concept: A clearly male canonical Manager Homie performs the iconic black-suit bent-knee twist.
pulp-fictioning-manager.action_expectation: Both connected distal forearms counter-rotate around fixed elbows while the male face, swept shoulder-length hair, bolo tie, torso, hips, legs and shoes remain fixed.

michael-burrying-manager.concept: A clearly male canonical Manager Homie in a faded blue pocket tee desk-drums with wired earbuds.
michael-burrying-manager.action_expectation: Exactly two connected forearm-hand-drumstick units alternate tabletop-directed strokes around fixed elbows while the male head, earbud wires, shirt core, chair, paper stack and desk remain fixed.

harvey-spectering-manager.concept: A clearly male canonical Manager Homie adopts a sharp closer-lawyer pose in a charcoal suit.
harvey-spectering-manager.action_expectation: One connected cuff-and-lapel forearm makes a compact confident adjustment around a fixed elbow while the male face, hair, tie, suit core, folder, other arm, legs and shoes remain fixed.
